name: Hori Kanade
source:
>High School Student
>Temporary Radio Personality

A high school student whose hobby is listening to radio.

Rather than play with her friends, Kanade prefers to listen to radio all alone. One day, when the local radio station was looking for volunteers, she applied and was accepted. At first she was just helping out with miscellaneous chores in the station after school, but when the main personality suddenly quit on short notice, she had to pick up the role of a radio personality herself.

Kanade has a reserved personality and doesn't like standing out. Despite her being very timid, she does her best at everything she tries and fulfills her duties well.

She's a resident of Umitsubame Town.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/natsuyo/character7.html]Official Site[/url]]
